# GMM Distributors Private Limited

> GMM Distributors Private Limited is an agricultural products supplier and distributor based in Arambagh, Hooghly, West Bengal, India. Incorporated on 23 October 2020 (CIN: U24299WB2020PTC240755), the company supplies organic manure, bio-organic manure, soil boosters, humic granules and related agricultural products for farmers, dealers and distribution partners.

## Company facts
- Legal name: GMM Distributors Private Limited
- Trading name: GMM Distributors

- Registered office: Nirmala Bhawan, Fansi Bagan, Ward No. 13, Arambagh, Hooghly, West Bengal – 712601, India
